name: @linga/frontend-bootstrap
comment:scripts: No --config flag on purpose: the path was relative, so it only resolved when the process already sat in this folder. Vite picks up ./vite.config.js from its own cwd, and every caller (root scripts, npm/yarn/pnpm workspace commands) runs the script with cwd set here.
comment:dependencies: js/detect.js and js/grammar-tool.js import these at runtime. They used to be declared only by @linga/frontend-react and reached here through hoisting, so a build of this workspace alone (or any isolated/pnpm layout) failed to resolve them. Versions are kept in step with the React workspace.
comment:build-deps: bootstrap, sass-embedded and vite are consumed by `vite build` itself (main.scss @imports bootstrap/scss/*, compiled by sass-embedded, bundled by vite) — not just by the dev server. A production-only install (`npm/yarn install --omit=dev` / `--production`, common on deploy platforms) strips devDependencies and leaves `npm run build` unable to find vite at all, which crashes the server at boot with a misleading 'frontend is missing' error instead of a clear install error. Keeping these as regular dependencies means `npm run build` always has what it needs, regardless of how the host installs packages.
